scripts.name: BSP\POWERUP.TXT
scripts.text:
grid 1
collision off
render off

;TYPE:
;0=ammo for ion gun
;1=ammo for lead buster
;2=ammo for magnetic plasma gun
;3=nitro crackers
;4=ammo for stun ray
;5=homie missiles
;6=sonic blast
;7=tnt mine
;8=fat lady
;9=static coating

;10=ion gun
;11=lead buster
;12=magnetic plasma gun
;14=stun ray gun

;20=engine repair
;21=fine cash-in

define type 0
define total_units 1
define minimum_units 1
define price_per_unit 0
define lifetime 0
define activate_msg 1000

waitfor 1 activate_msg
   powerup type total_units minimum_units price_per_unit lifetime
end

scripts.name: BSP\MARKER.TXT
scripts.text:
grid 1

collision off
render off

define ActivateMsg 9999
define KillMsg 9999

waitfor 0 ActivateMsg
  marker KillMsg
end

scripts.name: BSP\SENSOR2.TXT
scripts.text:
collision off
render off

define repeats 1
define sensor_range 0
define broadcast_range 120
define broadcast_message 0
define activate_msg 1001

waitfor 1 activate_msg
  sensor repeats sensor_range broadcast_range broadcast_message
end

scripts.name: BSP\LAUNCH2.TXT
scripts.text:
render off
collision off

;When receiving STARTKEY, this script will launch STARTAMOUNT cars of
;the specified type. Whenever one of them is killed, it broadcasts DEATHKEY

;This is useful for mission goals, so you can keep track of when a
;number of them has been hit

define StartKey 1100
define StartAmount 1
define DeathKey 1103
define type 0
define bounty 0
define speed 0

waitfor 1 StartKey
  launch StartAmount type bounty speed DeathKey
end

scripts.name: BSP\RELAY.TXT
scripts.text:
render off
collision off

define trigger 9999
define relay1 0
define relay2 0
define relay3 0
define relay4 0
define relay5 0
define relay6 0
define delay 1
waitfor 1 trigger
  timer2 1 delay delay
    broadcast 0 relay1
    broadcast 0 relay2
    broadcast 0 relay3
    broadcast 0 relay4
    broadcast 0 relay5
    broadcast 0 relay6
  end
end

scope: Original script parameters and cached-pointer/marker-removal instructions; not full original/source gameplay equivalence.
